detail.longDescription: You've probably used software built with Claude Code, maybe even already today. Companies like HubSpot and Atlassian use it to fix bugs and ship new features, and Anthropic itself reports that 80% of Claude's code was generated with its AI coding tool. Originally built for engineers, Claude Code packs a wide range of capabilities to speed up the software development process.
